next.reason: 1985: 'must be a mass storage file and must be open in the I-O mode at the time of execution of this statement'; 2023: "shall have an open mode of I-O. If the open mode is some other value or the file is not open, the I-O status ... is set to '49'". The I-O open-mode rule is kept, but 2023 REWRITE no longer requires a mass storage file (unlike its DELETE rule) and provides for line sequential files.
